7.3 The Rights of Individuals to Access Public Information
Principle 1: Right to access and obtain any public information – unprotected – by any public entity.
Principle 2: The right to be informed about the reason for the denial of the request for access to information.
Principle 3: The right to file a notice of appeal against the decision to refuse the request for access to information.
